sql: SELECT fish_date_season, COUNT(*) as trip_count, MIN(fish_date_doy) as first_doy, MAX(fish_date_doy) as last_doy FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 GROUP BY fish_date_season
SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as boat_count, ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, boat, landing, anglers, yt FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat
